image_description: A vintage black Remington Noiseless typewriter sitting on a wooden desk. The image focuses on the keyboard and carriage area. A sheet of white paper is loaded into the platen. To the left, there are papers and a blue sticky note with handwritten text. The keyboard features round, glass-topped keys with metal rims. The space bar is the long, horizontal lever at the bottom center of the keybed.
